methods.description: Split composite factors until every leaf is prime, then count repeated primes in index form.
Compare two starting pairs and show the same multiset of prime factors.
Repeatedly divide by primes, record each divisor and stop at1.
Correct a product containing a composite factor; contrast a prime number with no branches.
Adapt a known factorisation and check available prime multiplicities for proposed factors.
Use known factors to supply exactly the missing prime powers for the smallest permitted number.
Use the stated number of prime leaves and whether they differ to identify possible numbers.
